data.narrative:
Picogrid is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Zane Mountcastle, Martin Slosarik, and Dan Chirita that has raised $45M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 11 same-sector peers at the same or adjacent stage, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Castelion.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology, anchoring to the $45M raised proxy and applying a typical 2.0x Series A step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $90M. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company Defense & Security comparable set yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with the range spanning $125M (floor) to $3.0B (ceiling). The peer distribution reflects meaningful heterogeneity; five sampled peers valued at $1.0B–$3.0B (Twenty, Code Metal, Harmattan AI, Allen Control Systems, Dream Security) anchor the upper quartile.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $76.5M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $545M. Stage-progression methods suggest a conservative floor; peer comparables point materially higher. Key uncertainties include Picogrid's revenue traction relative to the sampled peer set, the degree to which raised capital correlates with demonstrated product-market fit in this sector, and whether the peer median reflects companies with comparable technology maturity and customer validation.
